g.title: BEVFusion_spconv_DDS_flow
g.text: BEVFusion Sparse Encoder — trainStation/DDS removal (Route A): export surgery + runtime rulebook precompute + ImplicitGemm wiring

g.title: cluster_export
g.text: A. EXPORT TIME (AWML, offline — one-time graph surgery)

g.title: cluster_runtime
g.text: B. RUNTIME (per frame — AWML eval: pipelines/sparse_rulebook_precompute.py ; autoware: preprocess/sparse_rulebook_precompute.cu)

g.title: cluster_gemm
g.text: C. INSIDE THE ENGINE — how the 4 tensors drive ImplicitGemm (per downsample conv)

g.title: e3
g.text: PROMOTE out[0..3] to graph inputs ; drop out[4]=num_act_out (no consumer)

g.title: e4
g.text: REWRITE consumer edges old node-output -> rulebook/<tag>/<slot>
=> graph inputs 3 -> 19 (+16) ; 12 ImplicitGemm edges now from inputs
=> Netron groups all 16 under one 'rulebook' box

g.title: e5
g.text: merge sparse+dense (strip 'sparse/' prefix) -> build TensorRT engine

g.title: r2
g.text: for each stage i: SpconvOps::get_indice_pairs_implicit_gemm(coords_i, spatial_i, ksize,stride,padding)
(same routine the in-graph plugin used ; uses geometry ONLY, no features)

g.title: r3
g.text: per stage i it returns the rulebook + count:

g.title: r4
g.text: stage i out_indices = stage i+1 input coords
(submanifold layers between don't change the coord set)

g.title: r5
g.text: each stage returns N_i as host int -> 4 SEQUENTIAL D2H readbacks
(cascade is data-dependent, cannot be merged ; same count as baseline
but now in preprocessing, off the engine critical path)

g.title: t_pf
g.text: feeding output j via kernel tap k (-1=empty)

g.title: t_ma
g.text: order rows so equal mask patterns

g.title: gemm
g.text: out[j] = SUM_k W[k] . in[pair_fwd[k,j]] over active taps
N reaches it via SHAPE: outputs[0].d[0] = inputs[3].d[0] (=pair_mask dim0 = N)
